# Chart corpus sources: one chart per line.
#   <name> <repo-url | oci-ref> [chart-name-in-repo]
# For OCI refs, the chart is the last path element of the ref.
# scripts/update-charts.sh resolves the latest version of each and rewrites charts.lock.
